questions.knowledge_point: Dividing a Real Number by a Complex Number
questions.worked_solution:
The denominator is $3+2\text{i}$ and its conjugate is $3-2\text{i}.$ We multiply both the numerator and the denominator by $3-2\text{i},$ so that the denominator turns into a real number:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}\frac{3}{3+2\text{i}} & =\frac{3}{3+2\text{i}}\cdot \frac{3-2\text{i}}{3-2\text{i}} \\  & =\frac{9-6\text{i}}{9-6\text{i}+6\text{i}-4{\text{i}}^{2}} \\  & =\frac{9-6\text{i}}{9-4{\text{i}}^{2}} \\  & =\frac{9-6\text{i}}{9-(4)(-1)} \\  & =\frac{9-6\text{i}}{9+4} \\  & =\frac{9-6\text{i}}{13}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Now that the denominator is a real number, we can write the complex number in the form $a+b\text{i}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}\frac{9-6\text{i}}{13}=\frac{9}{13}-\frac{6}{13}\text{i}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

questions.knowledge_point: Dividing a Real Number by a Complex Number
questions.worked_solution:
The denominator is $-2+4\text{i}$ and its conjugate is $-2-4\text{i}.$ We multiply both the numerator and the denominator by $-2-4\text{i},$ so that the denominator turns into a real number:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}\frac{5}{-2+4\text{i}} & =\frac{5}{-2+4\text{i}}\cdot \frac{-2-4\text{i}}{-2-4\text{i}} \\  & =\frac{-10-20\text{i}}{4+8\text{i}-8\text{i}-16{\text{i}}^{2}} \\  & =\frac{-10-20\text{i}}{4-16{\text{i}}^{2}} \\  & =\frac{-10-20\text{i}}{4-16(-1)} \\  & =\frac{-10-20\text{i}}{4+16} \\  & =\frac{-10-20\text{i}}{20}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Now that the denominator is a real number, we can write the complex number in the form $a+b\text{i}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}\frac{-10-20\text{i}}{20}=-\frac{10}{20}-\frac{20}{20}\text{i}=-\frac{1}{2}-\text{i}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

questions.knowledge_point: Dividing an Imaginary Number by a Complex Number
questions.worked_solution:
The denominator is $-1+4\text{i}$ and its conjugate is $-1-4\text{i}.$ We multiply both the numerator and the denominator by $-1-4\text{i},$ so that the denominator turns into a real number:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{4\text{i}}{-1+4\text{i}} & =\frac{4\text{i}}{-1+4\text{i}}\cdot \frac{-1-4\text{i}}{-1-4\text{i}} \\  & =\frac{-4\text{i}-16{\text{i}}^{2}}{(-1)^{2}-(4\text{i})^{2}} \\  & =\frac{-4\text{i}-16(-1)}{1-(-16)} \\  & =\frac{16-4\text{i}}{17}\end{aligned}
$$

Now that the denominator is a real number, we can write the complex number in the form $a+b\text{i}:$

$$
\frac{16-4\text{i}}{17}=(\frac{16}{17})+(-\frac{4}{17})\,\text{i}
$$

questions.knowledge_point: Dividing an Imaginary Number by a Complex Number
questions.worked_solution:
The denominator is $-2-3\text{i}$ and its conjugate is $-2+3\text{i}.$ We multiply both the numerator and the denominator by $-2+3\text{i},$ so that the denominator turns into a real number:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{4\text{i}}{-2-3\text{i}} & =\frac{4\text{i}}{-2-3\text{i}}\cdot \frac{-2+3\text{i}}{-2+3\text{i}} \\  & =\frac{-8\text{i}+12{\text{i}}^{2}}{(-2)^{2}-(3\text{i})^{2}} \\  & =\frac{-8\text{i}+12(-1)}{4-(-9)} \\  & =\frac{-12-8\text{i}}{13}\end{aligned}
$$

Now that the denominator is a real number, we can write the complex number in the form $a+b\text{i}:$

$$
\frac{-12-8\text{i}}{13}=(-\frac{12}{13})+(-\frac{8}{13})\,\text{i}
$$

questions.knowledge_point: Dividing a Complex Number by an Imaginary Number
questions.worked_solution:
Here, the denominator is the imaginary number $4\text{i}.$ Note that this can be written as $0+4\text{i},$ so the conjugate is $0-4\text{i},$ or simply $-4\text{i}.$

So, we multiply both the numerator and the denominator by $-4\text{i},$ so that the denominator turns into a real number:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{3+2\text{i}}{4\text{i}} & =\frac{3+2\text{i}}{4\text{i}}\cdot (\frac{-4\text{i}}{-4\text{i}}) \\  & =\frac{-12\text{i}-8{\text{i}}^{2}}{-16{\text{i}}^{2}} \\  & =\frac{-12\text{i}-8(-1)}{-16(-1)} \\  & =\frac{8-12\text{i}}{16}.\end{aligned}
$$

Now that the denominator is a real number, we can write the complex number in the form $a+b\text{i}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}\frac{8-12\text{i}}{16} & =\frac{8}{16}-\frac{12}{16}\text{i} \\  & =(\frac{1}{2})+(-\frac{3}{4})\,\text{i}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
